note: d(output)/d(raw scalar), DERIVATIVE convention, exact lri_framework gradients at order C8 (201 scalars). Outputs: C8 = 8 T4, B_old8 (old-input part; depends only on the 116 order-D4 scalars), B_done8, and the ten new inputs. 'sens_C8' = |dC8/dx| sorted. The gradients are polynomials in the other scalars: see point_dependence.

sources_by_priority.source: own engine: production all-log results, poles1, validation runs

evaluation_point.why_zero: not yet computed by our engine; 0 places the evaluation point only. point_dependence gives d(dC8/dx_i)/dy_j for each of them

point_dependence.use: dC8/dx_i(y) = signed['C8'][x_i] + sum_j d_dC8dx_d_zeroed[x_i][y_j] * y_j (exactly linear in each y_j: max_curvature ~ 0; products y_j y_k are not included)

0.025.rule: sigma_i = T / (|dC8/dx_i| sqrt(n)), n = 85 new scalars, T = 0.025 (= 0.0001 relative)

0.0025.rule: sigma_i = T / (|dC8/dx_i| sqrt(n)), n = 85 new scalars, T = 0.0025 (= 1.0e-5 relative)
